subject: Two-step runthrough needed after last-minute gatekeepers added
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@greenwave.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Need to rework this week's runthrough — new reviewers added

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on Monday — the product looked great. We just had a last-minute internal alignment here: Security (Vivek's team), Cloud Infra, and Procurement want to join the evaluation before we sign. That adds a couple of different review goals (technical deep dive, risk/controls review, and licensing/terms).

Two asks from our side:
- Can we split the scheduled demo into two shorter sessions (technical + procurement/finance) rather than one long meeting?
- We have two folks who will be traveling this week and available only in the afternoon PT on Thu/Fri.

Attached is a quick risk matrix and a procurement checklist so your team can see the scope. If splitting helps, we can do 45m for technical ops + 30m for procurement/contract Q&A.

Attachments: GreenWave_RiskMatrix.xlsx (xlsx), Procurement_Checklist.docx (docx)

Proposed windows: Thu 8/12 1:00–4:00pm PT or Fri 8/13 12:30–3:30pm PT. Let us know what you can accommodate — priority is getting Vivek's team in for the controls discussion.

Appreciate it,
Alice Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
GreenWave Analytics
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@greenwave.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need to rework this week's runthrough — new reviewers added

Thanks Alice — and noted on the travel constraints. Looping in a few folks on our side to propose a practical approach:

- My proposal: Split into two back-to-back seats (Session A — Technical Ops, 45m; Session B — Governance & Procurement, 30m). We can keep them adjacent so the GreenWave team doesn't have to join separate days. If your reviewers must be on separate days, we can make them independent slots.

- For Session A (technical): Karthik will cover scaling, networking, and private deployment options. He mentioned he needs the SOC2/high-level controls doc and any specific compliance scenarios you expect us to walk through.

- For Session B (procurement/governance): Priya will cover licensing/terms and enterprise SLAs; I will cover rollout and support model. Vivek, can you confirm if you want an internal threat model or just controls mapping in this runthrough?

Available windows (PT):
- Thu 8/12: 1:30–2:45pm (A) + 2:45–3:15pm (B) — contiguous
- Fri 8/13: 12:30–1:15pm (A) + 1:30–2:00pm (B) — 30m gap to accommodate travel handoffs
- Alternate: Thu 8/12 afternoon but split across two days if that makes travel easier (we can do Thu tech + Fri procurement).

I attached our SOC2 summary so Karthik and Vivek have something to review before the technical session.

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf)

Please confirm which of the windows works best for GreenWave and whether you prefer contiguous or split scheduling.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need to rework this week's runthrough — new reviewers added

Short note from Security:
- We prefer a targeted controls mapping (30–45m) during the technical session rather than a full threat-model workshop. Please have GreenWave share 3–4 compliance scenarios they are most concerned about (data residency, KV cache retention, and third-party telemetry).
- If you have any architecture diagrams, drop them into the invite or share a short OneDrive/Drive link. I'll be available for both Thu 8/12 contiguous slots and Fri 8/13 slots — Thu contiguous is slightly better for our schedule.

Karthik: we'll also need a short note on the private deployment network topology you plan to present (NAT/IGW/VPC peering specifics).

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@greenwave.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Singh <bob.singh@greenwave.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need to rework this week's runthrough — new reviewers added

Thanks Vanessa / Vivek — contiguous on Thu 8/12 works for us and keeps things simple for the travelling folks. Confirming:

Final plan (Thu 8/12 PT):
- Session A (Technical Ops): 1:30–2:15pm PT — Karthik & Vivek join; GreenWave to share architecture diagram + 3 compliance scenarios (we'll attach before EOD Wed).
- Session B (Governance/Procurement): 2:15–2:45pm PT — Priya & Vanessa; Bob will lead procurement/contract questions.

We'll accept the calendar invite for the contiguous 45m + 30m block. I've attached the procurement checklist you requested and put the risk matrix in the drive link. Also included is a preliminary DocuSign link for the NDA amendment that procurement asked for — we won't sign during the call but it's there to accelerate next steps.

Attachments: Procurement_Checklist.docx (docx)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/greenwave-risk
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/ABC-GW-1124

See you on Thu,
Alice Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
GreenWave Analytics
